title: Effect of dental cast analysis on orthodontic treatment planning – a prospective multicentric cross-sectional study
summary:
Orthodontic treatment is based on a precise diagnosis and
treatment plan for an individually tailored therapy with few side effects and high efficacy (Kraft et al. 2012). Although the three-dimensional analysis of diagnostic dental casts is part of routine orthodontic diagnostics, comparatively little is known about the clinical benefits of this diagnostic procedeure with respect to scientific criteria. 
Three-dimensional analysis of models of the upper and lower arch is used to evaluate single tooth misalignments and the interlocking of teeth in all three spatial planes. Initial intraoral diagnoses can be specified, although radiographs are often indicated for differential diagnosis. The results of the dental cast analysis, including the exact quantification of space balances or transverse discrepancies, have an impact on treatment planning – for example, on the question of whether teeth need to be removed or how the maxillary (arch) can be expanded (Naish et al. 2016; Antoszewska-Smith et al. 2017; Ali et al. 2018; Rasmussen and Viozzi 2020). However, no studies are available, which directly examine the influence of such a dental cast analysis on all essential aspects of orthodontic treatment planning. Furthermore, the number of relevant available studies is limited and methodologically rather of low quality. It is therefore desirable to prospectively recruit a large, representative study group in order to subsequently evaluate the influence of orthodontic three-dimensional models and their analysis on orthodontic treatment planning. This large-scale study should clarify whether three-dimensional models are necessary for medically correct treatment planning in patients of all age groups.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- orthodontic patients for early, regular or late treatment (no restrictions with regard to age, sex, ethnicity, anomaly, orthodontic pre-treatment) 
- complete pre-treatment diagnostic records (medical history, models, x-rays (orthopantomogram, lateral cephalogram), clinical intraoral examination including orofacial functions, clinical extraoral examination/photography analysis)
Exclusion criteria:
- complete pre-treatment diagnostic records (medical history, models, x-rays (orthopantomogram, lateral cephalogram), clinical intraoral examination including orofacial functions, clinical extraoral examination/photography analysis) not available
